purpose: MCUI substitutes after 3.14 (team-lead decision 2026-10-01: do not limit conservation sources to IUCN and the Korean list). Step 1: the official national red list of another range state. Step 2 (in the Rapid LC snapshot): a preliminary Rapid Least Concern check. Read only by configs that name this file. 3.16 adds the Russian Red Data Book row for Gelidium elegans. 3.27 (fork, 2026-10-03) adds the Swedish red list row for Ulva prolifera and the rule for choosing among several range-state lists (team-lead decision 2026-10-03). Configs up to 3.26 keep reading the 3.16 file. 4.0 (fork, 2026-10-04) adds the Fisheries Agency of Japan rarity evaluation (2017) rows for Paralichthys olivaceus and Gadus macrocephalus, published there as 'ランク外' and read as LC-equivalent under the team-lead decision of 2026-10-04. Configs up to 3.28 keep reading the 3.27 file.

range_state.list: 環境省レッドリスト2020 (貝類)
range_state.assessment_basis: Ministry of the Environment Japan red-list categories, which name their IUCN equivalent (準絶滅危惧 = NT)
range_state.continuity: NT in the 2015, 2017, 2018 and 2019 mollusc lists (as Crassostrea sikamea) and in 2020 (as Magallana sikamea); each CSV read 2026-10-02
range_state.limitations: A national assessment of Japan, where the species is confined to the Ariake and northern Yatsushiro seas; not an IUCN global or Korean assessment. In Korea it is known from few sites (Hong et al. 2012, Fish Sci 78:259). Never ranked or pooled with IUCN-based or Korean national MCUI.

range_state.list: Красная книга Российской Федерации (растения и грибы), Section 5 ВОДОРОСЛИ, row 594
range_state.assessment_basis: The list's threat-status column uses the IUCN codes defined in Order No. 306 para 3.7 (as amended 2020): 'У - Уязвимые (VU - Vulnerable)'. The rarity column ('3 - Редкие') is a Russian scale and is not mapped.
range_state.continuity: Row 635 of the 2005 list (Order No. 289) already held Gelidium elegans at rarity category 3; that list had no threat-status column, so the VU reading is first stated in the 2023 list.
range_state.limitations: Russia is the northern edge of the range (Amur Bay and Cape De-Friz, Peter the Great Gulf) and the species is recorded there as single finds, so this is a peripheral-population assessment, not a range-wide one. Japan, the centre of the range, does not list the species in the Ministry of the Environment algae red lists of 2020 or 2025 (the congener Gelidium hirsutum is listed); absence from a threatened-species list is not an LC assessment and does not overturn the Russian category. Never ranked or pooled with IUCN-based or Korean national MCUI.

range_state.name_as_published: Ulva prolifera O.F.Müll. (spretig tarmalg), Dyntaxa 232807; synonyms there include Enteromorpha prolifera
range_state.list: Rödlistade arter i Sverige 2025 (SLU Artdatabanken), Rodlistearbete_2025.csv row for taxon 232807
range_state.assessment_basis: The Swedish list applies the IUCN categories and criteria at the regional level; LC is an assigned category ('De skattade värdena ... ligger alla inom intervallet för kategorin Livskraftig (LC)'), not an absence from the list.
range_state.scope: national (Sweden: Skagerrak, Kattegat and Baltic coasts)
range_state.continuity: LC in the 2020 and 2025 Swedish lists (NE in 2010). Other range-state lists read on 2026-10-03: Norway, Rødlista for arter 2021 (Artsdatabanken), LC (also LC in 2015 and 2010); Finland, 2019 red list (Ministry of the Environment / SYKE, laji.fi MX.254295), DD.
range_state.selection_rule: Several range states list the species. Following the team-lead decision of 2026-10-03, the most recent government list that assigns an explicit category other than DD gives the MCUI; the other lists, including a DD, are shown as limitations.
range_state.limitations: A distant range state: Sweden, Norway and Finland assess North-East Atlantic and Baltic populations, not the North-West Pacific population around Korea (the project's reviewed native-range box for this species is the North-West Pacific). Finland's 2019 list gives DD for the same species. The Ulva linza-procera-prolifera complex is hard to separate, so the same name may not mean the same biological entity in both oceans. Never ranked or pooled with IUCN-based or Korean national MCUI.

range_state.list: 水産庁 水産資源の希少性評価結果 (2017), p.2, 整理番号 40
range_state.assessment_basis: An official government evaluation of the species in Japanese waters (Fisheries Agency, 94 species: DD 1, ランク外 93). 'ランク外' is read as LC-equivalent under the team-lead decision of 2026-10-04.
range_state.scope: national (Japan; stocks the Fisheries Agency assesses)
range_state.continuity: Single round (2017); Japan's next marine red-list round has not been published (checked 2026-10-04).
range_state.limitations: 'ランク外' means the evaluation assigned no category. The 2013 application guide for the marine red list says no category is assigned when extinction risk is not considered or when there is not enough information to evaluate it; the published table does not say which applies per species. The same table gives DD to one species separately, and every listed species is one whose stock the Fisheries Agency assesses every year, so the result is read as 'not threatened'. Treating it as LC-equivalent is a team-lead decision (2026-10-04), shown on the species. A national evaluation of Japanese waters, not an IUCN global or Korean assessment. Never ranked or pooled with IUCN-based or Korean national MCUI. Japan's FY2025 stock assessments (FRA, not used for the MCUI) put two of four stocks below SBmsy (日本海北部 0.66, 日本海中西部・東シナ海 0.53 × SBmsy, fishing above Fmsy) and two above (太平洋北部 1.52, 瀬戸内海 1.02).
